Morphine
[Erowid Note: 
Because opiate use can lead to significant tolerance (requiring higher doses for the same effects), the dose used by a first time user is significantly smaller than that used by a regular user. It can be extremely dangerous to choose ones dose on the basis of the amount taken by someone else. Overdoses of opiates can be fatal.]
[Erowid Note: 
Intravenous (IV) injection of crushed pills/tablets can be very dangerous due to unknown substances, binders, and fillers present. Any substance injected directly into the blood stream should be very pure. Clean needles and medically appropriate techniques should be used to avoid serious injury or death.]
The first time I took morphine I took a several 60 mg MS-Contin up the nose with bad taste but good effect. Then I could also get the 100mg oramorph Sr. I then got my tolerance up after repeated usage until I started needed to much. I would take 3 60mg MS-contins and 2 100 mg Oramorphs. I would feel good for about a couple hours then take more. Morphine does not last long especially after IV. I did not really care as I was getting the oramorphs for $7.50 a piece and the 60 mgs for $2-$3 a pc and cheaper in quantity. I would sell the 100's for 15.00-20.00 a pc and the 60mgs for about 6.00-8.00 a pc.Then the pills stopped working good when I took them orally so I started booting them. When I boot morphine I feel a strong rush that almost takes my breath away. Then I feel like their is pin pricks all over my body and then I feel a mild body and head buzz for awhile. It is a different feeling then heroin more like dilaudid.
